title: FenceWood
description: Allows fences to be used as wood with customizable drops!
body:
# **Decay & Drops**

### **Decay System**  
Trees naturally break down when their oak support is removed.

### **Configurable Timing**  
Custom decay delays and check intervals.

### **Custom Drops**  
Fully configurable loot tables for every fence type.

### **Decay Drops**  
Separate drops for naturally decayed fences.

### **Chain Breaking**  
Break multiple connected fences at once with an axe.

---

# **Conversion Tools**

### **Area Conversion**  
Convert selected regions into tree fences.

### **World Conversion**  
Convert entire worlds asynchronously.

---

# **Performance & Control**

### **Async Processing**  
Handles large-scale operations without lag.

### **Toggle Features**  
Enable or disable mechanics individually.

### **Performance Controls**  
Adjust threading and calculation behavior.
